studies.title: The silkworm
studies.caption: A silkworm feeds on mulberry leaves before spinning its cocoon. The cocoon's fine thread became the basis of silk production.
studies.prompt: Macro-scale natural-history study of creamy Bombyx mori caterpillar resting naturally on serrated mulberry leaf, small dark head, segmented body, tiny true legs and prolegs, short rear horn; one intact off-white oval cocoon beside twig. Clearly separate larva and cocoon, no butterfly wings attached to larva, no oversized teeth.
